author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: योगत्वभ्रान्तिनिरासायाह ॥ समत्वमिति । सङ्गत्यागस्याप्युपलक्षणं । त्यागोपेतं समत्वं योग इत्यर्थः
translation: V. Yoga is the path to knowledge. To take one's stand on Yoga is to pursue that path. Renouncing attachment to the fruits of Karma (the duties performed); and thereby being alike, i.e. being equally unaffected by success or failure; do thy duties for the sake of the Lord's grace.
